title: Koopa: Learning Non-stationary Time Series Dynamics with Koopman Predictors
claim_locator: NeurIPS 2023 paper, Table 1 and Table 6, Exchange, horizon 96

compatibility_patches.rationale: NumPy 2 removed the uppercase alias; both names denote positive infinity.

protocol.claim_locator: NeurIPS 2023 paper, Table 1 and Table 6, Exchange, horizon 96
protocol.protocol_note: The paper requires three different random seeds but does not publish their numeric values. Seeds 2021-2023 are frozen before execution; every resolved command is audited.
protocol.randomness_protocol: Three adapter runs with frozen seeds 2021, 2022 and 2023; the paper requires three seeds but does not publish their numeric values.
